title: Tool Use & Function Calling — Ask for an Action, Do Not Pretend It Happened
key_insight: A tool gives the model a named capability with described inputs. The model proposes a call, application code runs it, and the result returns to the conversation.
body:
## Ask for an Action, Do Not Pretend It Happened

A model is asked for today’s account balance. It cannot know the live value by continuing to guess text.

A tool gives the model a named capability with described inputs. The model proposes a call, application code runs it, and the result returns to the conversation.

The model does not execute authority by itself. The application owns credentials, validation, permissions, and side effects.
common_mistakes: A model response automatically has every system credential.
Retries are safe even when they repeat payments.
mini_exercise: Draw “Ask for an Action, Do Not Pretend It Happened” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: Models need tools to query live systems, calculate reliably, and take controlled actions beyond text generation.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Ask for an Action, Do Not Pretend It Happened,” explain Tool Use & Function Calling without assuming the listener knows modern AI.
